fusions.name: Switchback Throw
fusions.desc: A thrown jaw that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Blister Snap
fusions.desc: A quick snap that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tripline Mile
fusions.desc: Strings a line of jaws 7 tiles long for 10 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stride Ledger
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%. A jaw-escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.5 seconds.
